facts.did: runs to Deck 2 and finds the Osimidite Chamber hatch open; descends into heat and escaped osimidite mist, calling for Cosmer and fearing he may be dead

evidence.span:
Sisters, I pray. Please don’t let me find him dead.


I’m not sure what I would do with myself if I did.


But then I do know.


The airlock.

facts.did: finds Cosmer slumped against the brass tank, no mask, eyes shut, pale and barefoot; his condition is uncertain as she approaches slowly with fading hope

evidence.span: He’s slumped against the back of it.

relationships: Cosmer appears to have relapsed in the Osimidite Chamber; his survival is unresolved at chapter end.
